objective: Freeze scientifically sound LLM0/V1/V4/V5 matched evaluation and reuse only conservation principles from self-consuming-llm-minimal-loop; code, issues and experiments remain in this repository.

method.anchor: LLM0 fixed; all later arms assessed against same original-correct subset
method.zero_denominator: null; not retained and not zero
method.cause_attribution: Separate controlled ablation with fixed and hash-verified upstream output; observational stage delta is not causal proof
method.gold: separately adjudicated and salted-precommitted before genuine runs; released only after frozen output commitments
method.sample_reuse: historical H01-H16 diagnostic only; independent evaluation requires genuinely unseen corpus

verification.environment: authorized Mac remote executor; clean shallow clone to /private/tmp/llm-ec-retention-20261009; no GitHub Actions

R1.description: Independent, genuinely unseen, independently adjudicated bilingual/task-context-matched corpus and gold, precommitted before any output inspection

R2.description: Original LLM0 model/weights/prompt/tokenizer/decoding/runtime hashes and actual outputs for exact R1 inputs

R3.description: Genuine V1, V4 authorized and V5 policy-matched execution with identical visible case IDs and shared task contract

R4.description: Independent order-of-access/provenance audit, private gold separation, output freeze before gold release

R5.description: Predeclared critical/tail non-inferiority margins, sampling uncertainty and controlled strict-gate subtraction

gates.reason: Self-attested integrity/commitments and synthetic tests cannot prove unseen data, model provenance, time ordering or domain-general non-degradation.

next_action: Acquire independent R1 and baseline R2 without exposing private gold, freeze matched four-arm run manifests/policy inputs, then run R3/R4 with no model tuning from evaluation outputs; only afterward compute R5.
